reasons.detail: R1 — Diff shows interactive flow now uses multi-select for available agents and conditionally prompts `mainAgent` only when `selectedAgents.length > 1`, while single-selection flow skips that prompt.

R3 — `--agent` values are parsed with `parseSetupAgentOption` using comma split+trim, yielding ordered selected families and setting `mainAgent` to the first listed family, then non-interactive setup consumes those values.

R2 — `buildSetupAgentConfig` deterministically maps selected families + main agent into `agent.default` (`claude|codex`) and one of the allowed built-in `agent.useProfile` values; `buildSetupConfig` writes these into config.

R6 — Dual-agent interactive path prompts `agentFileTargets` as a multi-select (`AGENTS.md` and/or `CLAUDE.md`), and non-interactive dual-agent path resolves both files by default via `resolveSetupAgentFileTargets(..., mode: "non-interactive")`.

R9 — Existing config is normalized before prompting via `loadExistingDefaults -> resolveSetupAgentDefaults`, which handles family aliases, concrete provider-key defaults, and built-in `useProfile` names, then reuses those normalized values as wizard defaults and in rebuilt config.

R4 — The diff adds runtime and validation paths that resolve `defaultAgentProfiles` and `defaultAgentProviders` when user config omits built-ins, while merging user `agent.profiles`/`agent.providers` on top (including override-by-key behavior via object spread/`Object.assign`).

R5 — `src/setup.js` removes add-on merging of built-in `agent.profiles`/`agent.providers`; it only sets `agent.default/useProfile/workDir`, while spreading existing `config.agent` so user-defined `profiles`/`providers` are preserved. `src/upgrade.js` also removes built-in merge logic and only migrates legacy chapter shape. This matches the requirement to avoid injecting package defaults in normal setup/upgrade and retain unknown user entries.

R7 — Diff adds setup summary fields for `agent.default`, `agent.useProfile`, and built-in profile names, adds completion-time help text via `buildSetupAgentHelpText`, and updates configuration docs in both EN/JA with explicit override examples for `agent.profiles` and `agent.providers`.

R8 — The diff merges `defaultAgentProfiles()` into profile resolution and `defaultAgentProviders()` into provider merging, so concrete defaults like `codex/gpt-5.4` remain resolvable unless user config overrides them.
